title: Remove the /hello debug route from the application factory
description: Verified: flaskr/__init__.py:26-28 registers @app.route("/hello") returning "Hello, World!". This diagnostic endpoint ships unconditionally in create_app (not gated on debug/test mode) and is an unnecessary production surface. Corroborates assertions.md §3 S6 (Low). Not tracked by any existing feature.json.
notes: Resolved 2026-07-03: removed the @app.route("/hello") handler and its hello() function from flaskr/__init__.py, and deleted tests/test_factory.py::test_hello. To prevent reintroduction, updated .aidd/features/app-factory-and-configuration/feature.json (description + spec point 6) to drop the /hello route and explicitly forbid unconditional diagnostic routes in create_app. Verified: ruff clean and full pytest suite green (34 passed) after removing the /hello route and its test.
spec:
1. Remove the @app.route("/hello") handler and its hello() function from flaskr/__init__.py (currently lines 26-28).
2. Confirm the test suite stays green — tests/test_factory.py::test_hello (if present) must be removed or updated; grep tests/ for '/hello' before deleting.
Note: written against the current Flask app; under a Q2 stack port, drop the equivalent scaffolding health/demo route.

IMPORTANT: After resolving this finding, locate the feature.json file(s) in .aidd/features/ whose spec originally produced the code or pattern that caused this audit finding. Update those feature.json spec(s) to prevent this issue from being reintroduced during a feature-based rebuild.
